title: Dependency Issue Risk Log - n8n Template

startHere.heading: Dependency Issue Risk Alerts
startHere.subtitle: Google Sheets companion for the n8n GitHub dependency risk workflow
startHere.whatItDoes: Each weekday the workflow reads recently updated open issues from the GitHub repositories you depend on, scores each one for upgrade and production risk with OpenAI, and logs it here. Issues at risk 4 or 5 also go to one Slack digest, once each. Reruns update the same row, matched on url, so the log stays one row per issue.
checklist: Make your own copy of this spreadsheet before connecting it to n8n.
Connect Google Sheets OAuth in n8n and select your copy in both Google Sheets nodes (Read Logged Issues and 4. Log Issues to Google Sheets).
Keep the Dependency Issues tab and every header in row 1 unchanged. The url column is the match key, so keep it as plain text.
Connect Apify, OpenAI and Slack, list your repositories in node 1, then run the workflow once by hand.
Publish the workflow to turn on the weekday 9:00 schedule.

tabs.name: Dependency Issues
exampleRows: Queue mode: Redis pub/sub teardown precedes execution drain; MCP session registration fails during shutdown
Queue-mode shutdown can close Redis pub/sub before executions drain, causing MCP session registration to fail with "Connection is closed."
Object .compact() expression extension turns array values into plain objects
.compact() turns nested array values inside objects into plain objects, corrupting expression results for workflows using arrays.
SSO project role provisioning leaves stale team project memberships when the claim has no valid mappings
OIDC project-role provisioning can leave revoked project memberships in place, preserving access after claims no longer map to any project roles.
fetch adapter: stream responses without a body leave the abort listener and timeout timer behind
Fetch adapter stream responses without a body leave abort listeners and timeout timers behind, leaking resources and keeping Node alive longer.
Use cross-platform directory name in QS guide
README quick-start uses /tmp, which is invalid on Windows.
req.subdomains splits an IPv6 host that contains dots
req.subdomains incorrectly splits IPv6 hosts containing dots, producing wrong subdomain values for some IP-address hosts.
http adapter: req.setTimeout(0) via follow-redirects leaves a socket destroy listener that breaks other clients sharing http.globalAgent (socket hang up)
Since the timeout change, follow-redirects leaves a socket destroy listener on pooled sockets, breaking other clients that reuse them.
`AxiosError.prototype.toJSON()` can OOM when config includes an `httpAgent`/`httpsAgent`
AxiosError.toJSON() can grow memory unbounded and crash the process when request config includes an http or https agent.
res.redirect(undefined) sends invalid Location: undefined header
res.redirect(undefined) returns a malformed Location: undefined header, which can break redirects for callers passing no URL.
